senses.gloss: f. (v. preced.) made of white clay, unburned and flat clay-dish, a kind of tray extemporized for immediate use in the field.—Pl. אִירוֹנִיּוֹת &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:5">Eduy. II, 5</cite> <he>לפסין אי׳</he> ed. (Ms. <he>אלפסין ארנ׳</he>, Mish. Nap. <he>ארו׳</he>).
Bets. 32ᵃ חיר׳ Ms. M. (ed. חר׳) expl. = עיר׳ Ms. M. (ed. ער׳) = צעי חקלייתא field-dishes. [Rashi; from עיר used in country towns (!), hence coarse, unfinished.].
